ambient: A relay confirms a route and holds it.
The needle sits at nothing, with great precision.
Something changes source. It makes no difference and it was still the right thing to do.
description: A wall of jack fields, every cable seated properly, every route correct. You can follow any of them with a finger and arrive at an output with nothing on it. Whoever did this was careful, and that's the part you keep coming back to.
name: The Patch Bay

looks: Dressed, looped and tied off by somebody who cared about it.
Warm where they're handled. Cold along the runs.
You follow one and it arrives where it should, which doesn't help.
objects.name: the cables

looks: A meter with the needle resting exactly at nothing.
It's live. It has been live the whole time.
You put a hand near it and it doesn't respond, because it's working.
objects.name: the output

weather: The room is kept at the temperature equipment likes, which is slightly too cool for a person.
